taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-09, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-09, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-09 (Survey Area T)**

**Layer Sequence:**
- **Layer 1:** 975.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.86 m (surface to 1.86 m depth)
- **Layer 2:** 552.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 22.73 m (1.86 m to 24.59 m depth)
- **Layer 3:** 730.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.22 m (24.59 m to 25.81 m depth)
- **Layer 4:** 1710.8 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, terminating resistive basement

**Curve-Type Analysis:**
- Layers 1–2–3 ($975.4 > 552.4 < 730.5\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$) form an **H** segment ($r_1 > r_2 < r_3$).
- Layers 2–3–4 ($552.4 < 730.5 < 1710.8\ \Omega\cdot\text{m}$) form an **A** segment ($r_2 < r_3 < r_4$).

The calculated sequence defines an **HA** curve. The on-file classification of **AA** is erroneous and does not match the interpreted resistivity model.

{"curve_type_stated": "AA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
